basic_info.description: Charming Central Sunset tunnel entrance home ideally located just steps from Noriega Street shops and restaurants, public transit, Sunset Reservoir, Sunset Recreation Center, Judah Street MUNI lines, Irving Street eateries, and Golden Gate Park. This updated home offers a rare and desirable layout with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths on the top floor, including a spacious primary suite. The light-filled living room features the original fireplace and flows into a formal dining room and spacious remodeled kitchen with eat-in area. Main bathroom off the hallway was recently remodeled. An interior staircase leads to a spacious garage accommodating two-car tandem parking with plenty of space for storage or potential future expansion. The generous backyard is ideal for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing outdoors. Freshly painted inside and out, this home also features beautifully refinished original hardwood floors - making it move-in ready and full of charm!
